title: GeoJSON Feature Counter: How Many Features?
description: Count the top-level features in a GeoJSON file instantly with the GeoJSON Feature Counter — paste, read the number, done. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a sample file holding two points, a route line and a square counts 4 features — one per top-level Feature object, whatever geometry each one carries.
quick_answer: The GeoJSON Feature Counter tells you how many top-level features a GeoJSON object contains. Paste the GeoJSON and read the count instantly: the size of the cast — one per Feature in a FeatureCollection, one for a lone Feature, and zero apology for how simple the question is.

faq: Top-level Feature objects. In a FeatureCollection, the members of its features array; a lone Feature counts as itself. Nested structures inside geometries do not inflate the count.
A raw Point or Polygon contains no Features — the count is 0, correctly. Wrap geometry in a Feature (or let a converter do it) when feature semantics are needed.
A Feature with geometry: null still counts — it exists, carries properties and is legal GeoJSON. Nulls are cast members without costumes.
